claims: NATO stands for the North Atlantic Treaty Organization.
NATO is a political and military alliance.
NATO was created to provide collective security against the Soviet Union initially.
NATO's focus is now maintaining peace and defending against modern threats.

Article 5 states that if a NATO ally is a victim of an armed attack, all other members will consider this act of violence as an armed attack against all members and will take actions to assist, including the use of armed force.
NATO membership is comprised of 32 countries from Europe and North America.
NATO members include the United States, Canada, the UK, France, and Germany.
NATO decisions are made by consensus.
NATO consensus means all members must agree.
NATO is often called Organisation du traité de l'Atlantique nord (OTAN) in French.
